features: Premium Sound Performance: The 20Hz–20KHz frequency response captures deep bass, detailed vocals, and crisp treble, providing a balanced listening experience for every music genre, movie, and podcast.

Wide Device Compatibility: Compatible with Android smartphones, iPhones, tablets, laptops, desktops, smart TVs, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices. Easily switch between devices for music, work, gaming, or entertainment.
Built-in HD Microphone: Features an integrated microphone for crystal-clear hands-free calling, online meetings, video conferencing, and voice chats. Stay connected without removing your headphones.

Fast Charging & Reliable Battery: Recharge the headphones in just 2–3 hours using DC 5V charging. Enjoy up to 4.5 hours of continuous music playback and up to 250 hours of standby time for everyday convenience.

Perfect for Everyday Use: Designed for work, study, travel, gaming, workouts, and daily entertainment. The lightweight build and soft ear cushions ensure lasting comfort while delivering high-quality wireless audio throughout the day.
